rows.purpose: Find the CS2 folder (from --cs2 launch arg), export every assets row with the bundled Source2Viewer-CLI into the cache, show progress
Load cached glb/wav/svg/ttf at runtime and hand them out by asset id
Main menu: agent on a Dust II backdrop, PLAY panel with mode tiles, map tile, side, difficulty, settings
Load map render mesh + world collision, parse spawns, bomb sites, bake bot navmesh (cached)
Rounds, freeze/buy time, bomb plant/defuse/explode, economy, score, side win
Shared body for player and bots: health, armor, weapons, shooting, hitboxes, agent model + animation
First-person control with Source-style movement, weapon slots, buy menu, plant/defuse, building input
First-person arms and gun: CS2's viewmodel clips (draw/idle/shoot/reload per weapon set) with the agent's firstperson arms re-skinned onto the viewmodel skeleton
Graphics presets Low/Medium/High and render scale, applied live to the viewport, sun shadows and environment
Bot brain: buy, route to sites on navmesh, see/aim/shoot, plant, defuse, build cover
Fortnite-style building: 5.12 m grid, wall/floor/stairs/cone, wood/brick/metal, turbo build, edit grid (3x3 walls, 2x2 others), pieces collapse without support
Health/armor, money, ammo, round timer with team scores and alive counts, kill feed, crosshair, buy menu, build bar, scoreboard
Portal Gun: blue portal on the surface you shoot, orange from the tactical map; fighters, bot paths and bullets pass through; see-through views on Medium/High
Right mouse with the Portal Gun: radar of Dust II drawn from the navmesh, predicted enemy routes and recommended exits for the second portal

Melty test mode: when %LOCALAPPDATA%/Melty/test/bot-strike-dust-ii.json exists, report checks, auto-start a Classic 1.6 match with the player seat driven by the bot brain, keep playing rounds, never quit; watchdog logs and fails checks that never happen
Classic 1.6 ruleset: GoldSrc movement (bhop cap, jump stamina, jump on press), 1.6 weapon values and view-punch recoil, amber HUD
